title: Singapore's Deployment to Support Multinational Coalition against ISIS
what_it_is: Singapore's Deployment to Support Multinational Coalition against ISIS

sections.label: Coalition operations against ISIS
sections.summary: The coalition is working to capture Mosul and isolate Al-Raqqa, and ISIS has lost over 40% of its populated territory in Iraq and around 20% in Syria.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: The coalition is working towards capturing Mosul in Iraq and isolating Al-Raqqa in Syria, in order to dismantle ISIS' presence in these countries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: So, as a rough measure, since the start of operations, ISIS has lost more than 40% of the populated territory it once held in Iraq, and around 20% of its territory in Syria.

sections.label: Regional terror attacks and arrests
sections.summary: A grenade attack in Puchong injured eight, and Indonesian authorities arrested six suspects planning rocket attacks on Singapore from Batam.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: Nearer home, a grenade attack at a nightclub in Puchong that injured eight.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: And just a few days ago, Indonesian authorities arrested six suspects who were planning attacks on Singapore by using rockets launched from Batam against targets in Marina Bay.

sections.label: Terrorism-related detentions in Singapore
sections.summary: Singapore presently has 20 persons in detention, one on Suspension Direction and 22 on Restriction Orders for terrorism-related activities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: In Singapore, there are presently 20 persons in detention, one on Suspension Direction and 22 others on Restriction Orders for terrorism-related activities.

sections.label: SAF medical team to Iraq
sections.summary: SAF has agreed to deploy a medical support team for healthcare needs and medical triage of coalition troops and local residents in Iraq.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: SAF has, therefore, agreed to deploy a medical support team to address the healthcare needs and medical triage of coalition troops and local residents in Iraq.

sections.label: Singapore's contributions in Afghanistan
sections.summary: Singapore made a difference in Uruzgan by providing hospital personnel for troops and residents, and imagery analyst teams disrupted cells.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: And  if our contributions in Afghanistan can be compared with, we made a difference.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: We made a difference in Uruzgan when we provided personnel to tend to both the troops as well as the residents in Afghanistan through a hospital.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Our imagery analyst teams made a difference because we could disrupt cells.

sections.label: Weapons locating radar contribution
sections.summary: Our weapons locating radar made a big difference.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Our weapons locating radar made a big difference.

sections.label: US Secretary thanks imagery analysts
sections.summary: US Secretary of Defense Ashton Carter thanked an imagery analyst team whose work disrupted a terrorist bank and reduced terrorism financing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: In fact, it was when US Secretary of Defense Ashton Carter visited the imagery analyst team here that had come back, he personally thanked them because it was their work that allowed a particular terrorist bank that got disrupted, that reduced the means for them to finance global terrorism.
